image_edit_trial_arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Targeted pupil-only correction of ONE existing transparent Hu Tao sprite, expressing annoyance.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the EXACT sprite edit target. Image 2 is a SEPARATE transparent annotation layer, aligned pixel-for-pixel to Image 1 at 934 x 1685; cyan rings mark the two pupil/iris regions to edit. The rings are guidance only: omit every annotation from the result. Image 3 is approved neutral-v008 for identity and ordinary five-petal blossom design. Image 4 is her in-game model for costume and eye identity. Image 5 is the user's portrait art for rendering and eye detail. Images 3-5 are supporting references only; do not redraw the character, copy their poses or replace the target.
REQUESTED CHANGE: Correct only the small pale pupil silhouette inside EACH existing reddish-amber iris, so both match Hu Tao's natural pale cream-ivory FIVE-PETAL blossom pupils in the approved neutral (Image 3). Each pupil is one compact rounded blossom with EXACTLY FIVE distinct rounded petals around one solid center: one top petal, two around the right half and two around the left half. Five shallow valleys separate five petal tips. Use a filled flower silhouette, not a hollow ring, four-lobed cross, diamond, sharp star or generic round pupil. Keep the size and position close to the original pupil and retain the complete surrounding colored iris and reflections. Make both flowers readable and matching, especially her anatomical left eye on the viewer's right. Do not recolor the red-amber iris or turn the entire eye white.
PRESERVE: Change ONLY pixels needed for the pupil correction inside the two marked irises. Keep the exact existing eyelid shapes, gaze direction, eye size, eyebrows, lashes, nose, mouth, emotion, head angle, blush, pale skin, hair, hat, branch, outfit patterns, hands and fingers, posture, full-body proportions, softly full thighs, pose, framing, lighting, painterly linework and shading of Image 1. Keep every other visible part of the sprite identical; no fresh interpretation, smoothing, pose change, body change, recoloring, extra marks, text or effects. Preserve its 934 x 1685 full transparent canvas and the original silhouette/alpha edges. Return the FULL sprite with just the tiny pupil corrections; not an eye crop, diagram, before/after sheet or annotation layer.
